scientific_integrity: Proof given for every N, and exact-rational computations are explicitly delimited to finite diagnostic ranges. The combinatorial edge-isoperimetric result used in the proof is credited to its original author; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp constants hold only for finite cycles of size N>=3 with counting-measure norms and zero-mean sequences. A real extremizing family is constructed, but all equality cases are not classified; no higher-order generalization is asserted. The all-N real optimization uses Vasilev's cited isoperimetric theorem. Historical priority in periodic spline and biharmonic inequalities is not independently audited.
title: Sharp second-difference Sobolev constants on finite cycles
